note:
R29 — codec / decoder feasibility probe for the speech sample streams (read-only on sources; one sample per class is copied to the
session scratchpad, decode attempts run with the locally installed ffmpeg 8.1 (winget), every temporary file is removed).

Classes: X360 NHL 15 pbp (EALayer3 v1, 0x05), X360 NHL 13 pbp (codec 0x09, 32 kHz), X360 NHL 10 pbp (EA-XMA, 0x03), PS4 NHL 15 pbp (EA-MP3, 0x0b),
PS4 NHL 21 pbp (EA-Opus, 0x0c). Measures the SNS data-payload framing of each class and records whether ffmpeg decodes it (raw / after a
measured prefix strip / inside a synthesized RIFF-XMA2 header). Findings are written to <out.json>; no audio is retained.
Usage: python r29_codec_feasibility.py <out.json>
ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.1.1-full_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
